751-3480-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

341-1170-5131-6798--202.easyPrerequisites:
Umori has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-5131-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

3446-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

628-2511-7865.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2963-4872-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Teleportation Circle.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

224-5627-7705.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
224-5627-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
224-5627-7705.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a 1/1 Minion creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

1169-1368-2033-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1169-1368-2033-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4359-4613-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4359-4613-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4359-4613-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

997-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
997-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

147-2292-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

225-539-3634-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
225-539-3634-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping The Core.
Repeat.
225-539-3634-6071.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

38-671-5220-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Skirk Prospector enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control

515-1636-3028.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Nissa, Vital Force.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-4905-5220-6634.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2957-3767-3918-3941.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

586-2921-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-2921-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2178-5256-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2178-5256-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1305-4927-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

1306-1594-1690-2538.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
1306-1594-1690-2538.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1306-1594-1690-2538.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2523-5560-5686.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2523-5560-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

957-1987-4423-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
957-1987-4423-4477.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

751-1770-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
751-1770-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning it and Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the seven lands can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1247-1528-4036.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Seething Song.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

864-2034-2104-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
864-2034-2104-5131.description:
Cast Eternal Witness from your graveyard by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
